
### ‘slots’  {.smaller}



* if packets take a fixed amount of time…
* want to wait whole number of packet times 
   * immediately after, one after, two after, three after
* avoids requiring almost 2 packets worth of ‘quiet’ time
   * collisions are always transmitting at "same" time
   * no "I started transmitting while someone else was transmitting"
* synchronize by observing end of last transmission, or central clock
* slotted Aloha: 36% utilization (twice "naive" version)
